ai_review.summary: Cloudy audience recording with indistinct mix and weak bass; no musical highlights noted.
ai_review.review: The reviewer finds the AUD source murky and lacking in low‑end, making instruments hard to separate. No specific performance strengths or weaknesses are mentioned, so the show itself cannot be evaluated from this review alone.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review, rating 0 stars and describing poor audio quality; no positive comments about the performance to offset the low score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is cloudy and indistinct with a noticeable lack of bass, making the sound muddy.
